objects.taxonomy_description: Cylindrical stick of wax (15-30 cm tall, 2-5 cm diameter) with a central wick (cotton string) extending from the top. The wax body is smooth and uniform, available in white, ivory, or colored varieties. The surface has a matte or slightly glossy finish depending on wax type (paraffin, beeswax, soy). The top has a charred wick tip if previously burned. Taper candles narrow toward the top; pillar candles maintain uniform diameter. The base is flat for standing. Scented candles may have a slightly textured surface from fragrance oils. The overall shape is a simple vertical cylinder with a thin wick protruding from the center.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.

objects.taxonomy_description: Medium-sized freshwater to brackish water turtle measuring 12-25 cm in carapace length. Carapace is oval and moderately domed with a smooth surface; coloration varies from brown to olive with concentric growth rings visible on each scute. Some species exhibit ornate patterning with yellow or orange markings on dark scutes. Plastron is large and hinged, enabling partial closure. Head is moderately sized with a pointed snout and small eyes; skin coloration is grey to olive with distinctive striped or spotted patterning on the head and neck. Limbs are moderately long with webbed feet and sharp claws. Tail is short. The turtle exhibits a characteristic basking posture on logs or banks with limbs extended and head raised. Skin texture is smooth with fine scales. Adapted for both aquatic and terrestrial environments, spending significant time basking to regulate body temperature.
